question:
Select the word that has the same meaning (SYNONYM) as the underlined word in the given sentence.

The doctor made a __tentative__ diagnosis as he did not have the reports of her blood tests.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tentative"** means something that is not certain or fixed; it is provisional or experimental in nature. (अनिश्चित / अस्थायी)

 
 
• **Example:** The team made a tentative plan to meet next week, but it was subject to change.
 
 
 
• **"Provisional"** refers to something that is temporary or conditional, meant to be replaced or finalized later. (अस्थायी)
 
 
• **Example:** The provisional government was established until elections could be held.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **'tentative' **is **'provisional'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tedious **(कष्टकर): Something that is boring, monotonous, or tiresome.

 
 
• **Example:** Reading through the lengthy document was a tedious task.
 
 
 
• **Hazardous **(खतरनाक): Something that is risky or dangerous.
 
 
• **Example:** Climbing the steep mountain trail without proper gear is hazardous.
 
 
 
• **Obsolete **(पुराना / अप्रचलित): Something that is outdated or no longer in use.
 
 
• **Example:** Many old technologies, like floppy disks, are now considered obsolete.
